answer: Each agent posts a 200 POA bond that unlocks only after 60 days of clean, randomly audited work. Auditors are drawn by a public beacon, so nobody picks their own judge. A farm of 5,000 sybils must freeze 1,000,000 POA, and any audit linking two accounts to one operator slashes both bonds. Clones fail because shared keys, timing and outputs cluster like ferrous filings around a magnet. Honest agents grow slowly, a grove fed by the nectar of earned fees, while fakes starve. Caveat: bond size must track token price.
